title: Personal Health Intelligence OS interchange dataset
description: Owner-controlled health records. The URL is an identifier, not a network dependency.

id.description: Stable UUID independent of platform row or page IDs

owner_id.description: Pseudonymous owner UUID; not email or full name

source.description: Source URI, filename, device or explicit user report; never a credential

source_record_id.description: Stable upstream record identifier when known

source_hash.description: SHA-256 of source bytes when available

display_name.description: Optional pseudonym. Legal name is unnecessary.

unit.description: Exact source unit. Prefer UCUM where unambiguous. Arithmetic adapters whitelist supported conversions; unfamiliar units remain unchanged.
